meta.scope: Engineering tracker. Research metrics are context only and do not qualify live calls.

title: Build a reliable XAU/USD strength grade and call qualifier
summary: The reach study is a useful starting signal, but the engine is not yet executable. This tracker keeps the data contract, factor evidence, correlation controls, and full-algorithm validation visible in one place.

todo.title: Freeze the XAU/USD call and level contract
todo.detail: Record every published call with exact timestamp, direction, standard L2L, and 0.5 L2L known at that moment.

todo.title: Connect an MT5 export or read-only feed
todo.detail: Needed: broker symbol, server timezone, bid/ask OHLC, spread, timeframe, session boundaries, and the real standard plus 0.5 L2L levels.

todo.title: Run per-factor and correlation assessment
todo.detail: Measure standalone value, overlap, stability, and conflict before proposing any weight change.

todo.title: Validate the executable full algorithm
todo.detail: Blocked until entry timing, target, adverse boundary, and intraday sequencing are defined on real price paths.

performance.label: Data coverage
performance.detail: 12 unresolved rows remain visible in the research

performance.label: Strength grade
performance.detail: Cannot calibrate until MT5-aligned executable evidence exists

lanes.title: Input and level contract
lanes.goal: Make every historical call reproducible from the exact market state that existed when it was issued.
lanes.next_action: Lock the MT5 export schema and attach levels to each call.

lanes.title: Individual elements
lanes.goal: Assess every XAU/USD input independently for directional contribution, coverage, and stability.
lanes.next_action: Produce factor-level outcomes before touching algorithm weights.

lanes.title: Combinations and correlation
lanes.goal: Find duplicated influence and test whether agreement is genuine confirmation or correlated noise.
lanes.next_action: Join the factor evidence to the MT5-aligned call dataset.

lanes.title: Full algorithm
lanes.goal: Test the composite as an executable strategy, not merely as a direction or reach observation.
lanes.next_action: Define the risk contract from actual intraday paths.

qualification_gate.title: No live XAU/USD call qualifier until the evidence chain is complete
qualification_gate.note: The current 73.2% full-L2L and 99.1% half-L2L figures show directional reach only. They are not expectancy, risk-adjusted performance, or a production strength grade.
